title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Timing of Isha salah 12469 views Q. Darood in namaaz 1987 views Q. I work in Saudi Arabia and go back home after every one year. I belong to Nainital district of U.P. (Now Uttarakhand) which is very near to Bareilly and the Barelwi Maslak is rampant in that area. "Mazar parasti" and Urs, etc., are the foremost part of their Islam and Aqeeda. In my village there are only two mosques and the Imams leading the prayers are staunch Barelwi. I had a discussion with one of these Imams of our moque, he has the belief that to ask for help (Mannat) with the dead (Mazar) is as good as praying God. Since then, I stopped praying with him. I offer all my five prayers in my home during my vacation of one month or so. Secondly, my wife is very punctual in prayers and other Shariah matters. She also joins my prayers which I lead in my house. Please enlighten me on;(1)if, under the circumstances explained above, my prayers in my home are correct, (2) prayers led by me and joined by my wife are correct. or I should go the mosque and pray behing the same Imam as explained above. I shall highly appreciate your immediate reply on the above e-mail address. Best regards 2929 views Q. I use to travel for my office work to place which is far around two hundred km from my residence 2378 views Q. Awarness about wajibat 3393 views Q. I work in a government office. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 36680 Country: India Title: If I do more ibadah I get a waswasah that people who are watching me have jealous on me Question: If I do more ibadah I get a waswasah that people who are watching me have jealous on me. What is the solution in Islam? Answer ID: 36680 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 315/315/M=1433) Do not leave the extra worship due to jealousy of people or satanic waswasah. Well, you should not develop pomp and pride. Make it sure that you do not have intention to be called worshipper. Your intention should be to please Allah purely, and keep on removing the doubt. May Almighty Allah save you from the evil of envies and Satan and nafs! Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
